explanation: The value is always near maximum at GO (10 when choosing a1, 9 when choosing a2, and 8 for a2 early in the episode), and low at D1 (0-1 after a rewarded trial, 1-3 after an unrewarded one). At D2 it follows how much the agent has been sticking with a1: about 1 when it chose a2 (whichever state it reached), 2-3 on the first a1 trial after a2 choices, rising to 4-5 over several a1 trials in a row, especially when they were rewarded (an unrewarded trial lowers it by about 1).
